topics.label: Introduction and lecture learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the introductory framing and sets out the key learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Determinants of cancer risk and epidemiological variation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how intrinsic genetic processes, environmental exposures, and geographic variations influence cancer incidence and public perceptions of risk.

topics.label: Mechanisms of carcinogenic agents and tumor promoters
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the molecular and cellular mechanisms by which biological, chemical, and physical agents act as tumor initiators, promoters, or host-dependent drivers of carcinogenesis.

topics.label: Methods for identifying carcinogens and evaluating exposure risk
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the genomic, epidemiological, in vivo, and in vitro approaches used to determine carcinogenicity and assess human exposure risks.

topics.label: Lecture summary and conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It delivers the concluding summary and final wrap-up of the lecture.
